description: This PHP class 'TerminationReasonMenuConfigurator' implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Pim\Menu'. It appears to configure menu options related to termination reasons in the OrangeHRM application's PIM module. The class uses a trait for helper functions and overrides the screen to 'viewTerminationReasons' when its configure method is called.

classes.name: TerminationReasonMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring menu options related to termination reasons within the OrangeHRM PIM module. Implements screen override logic.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen to 'viewTerminationReasons' using a helper method from the trait. Returns null.
